youtube.baslik: Why don't the semicircular canals sense steady rotation? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: When the head turns, the bony canal moves with it, but the endolymph lags behind by inertia and bends the cupula. If rotation continues at a constant speed, the fluid turns with the canal and the cupula returns within a few seconds; so the canals sense changes in speed.

bilgiler: As the head turns, endolymph lags behind and bends the cupula.
At constant speed, the fluid turns with the canal; the cupula returns.
The canals sense changes in speed, not steady speed.

cumleler: Why don't the semicircular canals sense steady rotation?
As the head turns, the canal moves but endolymph lags behind.
This relative flow bends the cupula and excites or inhibits hair cells.
If rotation continues at constant speed, the fluid turns with the canal.
The cupula returns within seconds; the canals sense changes in speed.
